newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL bucks trend on bearish Budapest bourse.
newsitem.headline: MOL bucks trend on bearish Budapest bourse.

text.p: Hungarian share prices closed mostly lower on the Budapest Stock Exchange as investors turned uncertain about the market's outlook after successive index records on Tuesday and Wednesday, traders said.
On Thursday the BUX index closed at 3,551.12 points, down 30.14, losing more ground than it had gained in the last two days.
"Investors turned uncertain about stocks that firmed eight, ten or more percentages points in the past few days," Attila Berecz of Raiffeisen Securities said.
Some investors were more determined and decided to unload papers to lock in profits, like in the case of hotel firm Danubius which fell 70 forints to close at 3,000.
One of the shares that managed to buck the trend was oil and gas company MOL putting on 20 forints to end at 1,540 in heavy trade.
BUX index futures were steady or little changed for the three nearest maturities and were weaker by 22.50 to 50.00 points for the three longest termins.
